mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('ROLE_', r.code) FROM role r INNER JOIN user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT a.code FROM authority a INNER JOIN role_authority ra ON a.id = ra.authority_id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ra.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
